verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API with an endpoint reference, rate limits, webhooks, UI integrations, custom channels and an MCP server. Nothing in the pack mentions official client SDKs or language libraries, and no OpenAPI spec exists from which to generate one. A raw REST API is a building block, not an official SDK, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
